title: Best Ps5 Pro (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.

verdict.line: Picture a gamer who wants the highest graphics performance and 2 TB of storage; the PS5 Pro delivers that with a smaller design and quiet operation. The main catch is its high price and lack of a disc drive.
